lineage: Successor of Ryuk (Wizard Spider/TrickBot ecosystem); shut down May 2022 and splintered into Black Basta, Royal/BlackSuit, Karakurt and other crews that still reuse the leaked playbook (2024-2026)
summary: Conti was a Russia-based, highly centralised RaaS run by the Wizard Spider/TrickBot organisation, linked to 1,000+ attacks by March 2022. Access came from TrickBot/BazarLoader/IcedID phishing, purchased or stolen RDP/VPN credentials and rapid exploitation of edge bugs (ProxyShell, Log4Shell on vCenter). Hands-on operators followed a leaked, step-by-step playbook: Cobalt Strike, AdFind and ShareFinder discovery, Kerberoasting, NTDS dumping, AnyDesk/Atera persistence, Rclone exfiltration to MEGA, then multi-threaded encryption over SMB.
uniqueTraits: Leaked operator playbook (Aug 2021) standardised affiliate tradecraft: adfind.bat, Invoke-ShareFinder, Invoke-Kerberoast, ntdsutil IFM
Atera/AnyDesk RMM agents installed as fallback persistence when Cobalt Strike was blocked
Rclone with MEGA configuration as the standard exfiltration channel
Fast weaponisation of ProxyShell and Log4Shell (VMware vCenter) for initial access/lateral movement
Encryptor targets network shares over SMB with up to 32 concurrent threads and skips the local host via command-line modes
